protocol: LCBT v3.1 + LCE v3 + PLES v3

origin_selection.known_overlap: PLES tails beyond tau=input_len-1 may overlap between origins

aggregation.strata: mean within stratum, then equal over tod inside a day type, day types by calendar share 5/7 and 2/7
aggregation.cohort_set: pooled rows use non-saturated cohorts only

phase_rule.Cold: join tau=0; one post-join input point
phase_rule.Onset: fault tau=0; one failed input point

ples.pre_event_usage: implementation assertion only; identical by construction, never reported as a score

bootstrap.design: origins and cohorts are crossed, not nested
bootstrap.outer_reason: PLES trajectories of neighbouring origins overlap, so origins are not independent; whole days are
bootstrap.cohort_resampling: one global draw per bootstrap sample, applied to every sampled block

join.treatment: same cohort joins at event origin

fault.treatment: same cohort fails at event origin
